name: Igarashi Ren
source:
An androgynous boy in the second year of junior high school. He's so cute that he himself knows it. He loves the twins.

"If I join the Juuichi family, I can play together for the rest of my life!" he thinks.

[Translated from [url=http://bellkage.blog.jp/llfl.html#story]official website[/url]]
